tests.reason: C1 ships dark: POST /api/v1/health/ingest and POST /source-state answer 409 INGEST_DISABLED whenever VITANA_ENV=staging (staging shares the production database), whatever HEALTH_SYNC_INGEST_ENABLED says, and HEALTH_SYNC_INGEST_ENABLED is set on no task definition. A POST probe is never sent to staging; the 409 before auth, the body or any port is proven by health-ingest.test.ts, as are the per-IP limit before auth, the per-member limit after it, gzip and the zip-bomb bound, the strict schema, the delegated-token refusal and the signed-in GET /status answer (ingest_enabled:false, store_pending) — the http runner signs nobody in. The adapter (consent per category with unconsented records dropped before A, deletions always passed through, idempotency, the S3 mapping table, SOURCE_PAUSED, OASIS payloads without values or record ids) runs over A's S10 fake and an S6 fake; the golden fixtures published for the native team are replayed by golden.test.ts. The migration (catalogue rows, connector rows, CHECK supersets, fn_set_health_consent with native_health_sync, the VTID-05156 revoke still in place, the prerequisite guard) is proven on a throwaway Postgres by scripts/ci/sql-tests/run-health-sync-consent-test.sh (CI SQL-HEALTH-SYNC-CONSENT.yml) and is applied to Supabase only via RUN-MIGRATION.yml after Gate 2. The legacy POST /api/v1/health/wearables/ingest 410 SUPERSEDED body is proven by health.test.ts (POST, not probed on staging).
